scientific_integrity: A complete analytic proof of the all-integer, continuous-perimeter sharp inequality and equality classification, with independent radial quadrature and symbolic spot checks. Prior exact unit-disk intersection areas are explicitly credited. No external or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only equally spaced congruent disks in the Euclidean plane; no arbitrary-center extremum. Underlying area/perimeter profile was known; new claim concerns its global excess optimizer and best quadratic stability. Historical priority provisional.
title: Half-perimeter extremizers and sharp quadratic lens-gap stability for regular disk intersections
